_comment: Skill tiers used by init_project.py and update_framework.py. tier=core: always installed; tier=stack: installed when the project's base stack or an add-on (web, gas) is listed in `stacks`; tier=optional: installed only with `--skills <name>` or when listed in [skills].enabled.

session-closeout.trigger: 使用者說「結束對話 / 收工 / wrap up」時

code-review-guard.trigger: 寫完或重構程式碼後、commit 前

tdd-bugfix.trigger: 實作新功能或修 bug 時（先寫失敗測試）

adr-issue-tracker.trigger: 做出架構取捨、或發現需記錄的 bug/坑時

api-adapter-scaffold.trigger: 串接新的外部 API / 服務時

frontend-design.trigger: 建立、美化或審查網頁 UI / 元件時（含視覺品味 Anti-Slop 審查）

legacy-migration.trigger: 專案有 docs/migration/MIGRATION.md，要繼續或完成舊專案遷移時
